text:
Zara: Passing Deepwell Diagnostics to CS — signed, BAA in place. ACV $240k (MRR $20k). Pilot/go-live target 2026-05-03. Requirements: private deployment (VPC), Azure AD SSO, customer-managed TLS certs, strict PHI logging, and KMS integration. Sales flagged an expected burst on day-one (~750 reqs/min). Main risks: Azure metadata delay, cert handoff timing, peering slot availability. cc @kevin @hema

Kevin: Thanks Zara — Ill own onboarding and the enablement deck. Who is the Azure admin and do we already have SAML/metadata? Also need cert contact and KMS key policy owner.

Zara: Azure admin is idops@deepwell.io. Uploaded a placeholder SAML metadata file to the account folder (internal). Certs will be customer-managed; customer wants a dry-run. KMS intent: customer-managed keys in GCP.

Hema: Ill raise infra tickets. Created SUP-9001 for SSO support and ENG-9002 for VPC peering/preflight. Eng needs CIDR ranges, peer project IDs, and preferred peering maintenance window. Left a comment for idops@deepwell.io on ENG-9002.

eng-bot: ENG-9002 created and assigned to eng-infra oncall. SUP-9001 created and assigned to support.

Kevin: TL;DR action items Ill track: 1) Collect final Azure SAML metadata from idops@deepwell.io (owner: kevin, due: 2026-04-10) 2) Coordinate cert dry-run with customer (owner: zara, due: 2026-04-08) 3) ENG preflight + ENG-9002 (owner: hema) 4) Enablement + PHI runbook session (owner: kevin, scheduled: 2026-04-20) 5) Burst capacity plan (owner: ops, note: request 2x A100 for pilot day)

Zara: Renewal note — 12mo term. Recommend QBR at month 7 to review adoption. Flagging renewal-risk: medium due to initial evaluation by clinical teams.

Hema: Quick smoke test for CS to run against staging once provisioned:

curl -X POST https://staging.redwood.internal/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer <TEST_TOKEN>' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"input":"PHI redaction check: Patient: Sam Rivera, MRN: 112233"}'

Kevin: Well run that and validate redaction + logging scrubbers. Ill create a Confluence onboarding page and attach the runbook + ticket links, will post link here when ready. :thumbsup:

Zara: Customer expects a go/no-go sync 2026-04-30. Please surface blockers by 2026-04-24 so we can escalate.

opsbot: Reminder set: follow-up 2026-04-22 10:00 PT (auto).

Kevin: Noted — will update this thread after the cert dry-run. Thanks all.
